notes: «فسألت هشاما عنه فحدثنا عن أبيه، عن عائشة» is a second route of the same saying: Hisham is the one asked and answers, so he is a link (rule 5)
«آل، عروة» is written with a comma and reads as garbled in the text; it is kept as written and the first route stops at Urwa, because the text names no Companion there
«قال سفيان وهذا أشد ما يكون» is Sufyan's remark and is not a link
